description: ADMIN ONLY. Text-to-VFX or image-to-VFX: interpret a prompt or reference into an editable animated effect specification. No Library save or credit charge. Pass the resulting type, style, look, color, duration, width, name, emitters and generation to gripforge_vfx to save/export (1 credit). Image mode requires a configured vision provider.

image_data.description: PNG/JPEG/WebP base64 data URI, up to 8 MB decoded.

image_id.description: Owned Library image id; use instead of image_data.

preset.description: Load a ready-to-play preset instantly, without AI. Supply this field alone.

prompt.description: Effect description; optional with an image.

name: gripforge_vfx_generate
